annotations.title: What should I work on now?

description: Prioritised "do this next" list for the project: blocked auto-fixes first (with the unblock action), then reporters waiting for an answer (they replied in the in-app thread since you last looked), then in-flight fixes to shepherd to merge, then user-felt classified reports by severity, with robot/cron chores (dependency bumps) last. Returns { steps: [{ priority, action, reason, tool, args }], summary }. Read-only. Call this first when the user asks "what needs my attention / what should I triage or fix".

projectId.description: Project UUID (defaults to the configured project). (`project_id` is accepted too.)
